title: If You're Happy and You Know It
transcription:
If You're Happy

If you're happy and you know it,
Clap your hands. Clap-clap
If you're happy and you know it,
Clap your hands. Clap-clap
If you're happy and you know it,
Then you really ought to show it,
If you're happy and you know it,
Clap your hands. Clap-clap

For following verses, repeat first verse and
substitute new words and motions:

If you're happy and you know it,
Stomp your feet. Stomp-stomp

If you're happy and you know it,
Shout HOORAY!

If you're happy and you know it,
Do all three. Clap-clap, stomp-stomp,
HOORAY!
